$comment: The GITHUB_TOKEN permissions each workflow in .github/workflows/ is allowed to request. tests/test_workflow_permissions_policy.py reads every workflow and fails when one asks for anything not written here, when a workflow is missing from this file, or when an entry here names a workflow or job that no longer exists. So widening a token's reach takes two edits a reviewer sees side by side: the workflow, and this file. `workflow` is the top-level permissions block; null means the file declares none. `jobs` lists only jobs that declare their own block; a job not listed must not declare one. See docs/SECURITY-AI.md.
